note: Derived from RequirementRegister.for_phase("26"): 6 requirements owned by lifecycle.release and evidence.artifact (5 MANDATORY: ARK-REQ-0007, 0015, 0124, 0125, 0350; 1 CONDITIONAL: ARK-REQ-0369). All six are pre-existing register entries (MS §Product Plane, §Frozen technology direction, §Supply-Chain Security; VDC §Provenance, §Final delivery), not added this phase. This phase implements C-31 Release Manifest + SBOM: the first real production use of the already-declared Release state machine, a real Release Authority reading the unmodified StableRevisionPointer, real C-14 provenance/SBOM/suspicious-package-review artifacts, and the real HUMAN_GATE_7 singleton wiring that closes the guard's own long-standing gap. It does not build real deployment, real code signing, or any live goal-to-product pipeline -- DEF-009 remains open and is explicitly not touched by this phase's scope.

claims.implementation: release_manifest.ReleaseAuthority.declare_release_candidate refuses before constructing anything if StableRevisionPointer.current() is None -- there is nothing to package before a Stable Core revision exists. This is the literal mechanism behind "Stable definitions take effect from first Release-Authority designation": a Stable Product revision (MS's own distinct term from Stable Core revision) has no meaning until this Release Authority's first real DRAFT declaration exists, and that declaration can only ever reference an already-designated Stable Core revision. docs/contracts/release_manifest.md §3 records the reconciliation between the two MS-named Stable kinds.
claims.evidence: doc: docs/contracts/release_manifest.md §3 states the mechanism and its reconciliation with MS's own two-sentence definition; the register assigns this requirement doc-only evidence, discharged by that document together with the real refusal behaviour it describes, proven directly by test_release_manifest.py::TestNoReleaseBeforeStableCoreExists::test_declaration_is_refused_before_any_core_promotion.
claims.note: The single register evidence key (doc) is supplied, backed by real, executable refusal behaviour rather than prose alone.

claims.implementation: release_provenance.register_release_provenance registers a release candidate's declaration as a real, content-addressed C-14 artifact (evidence.artifact.store.ArtifactStore, Phase 6, reused unmodified through a structural ArtifactRegistrar Protocol) with real Git-linked revision identity (candidate.core_revision_id, a genuine content address StableRevisionPointer itself recorded) and real content hashes (the artifact's own address, re-verified after write via ArtifactStore.verify/content_of).
claims.evidence: prov: test_release_provenance.py (4 tests: real C-14 registration, byte-identical re-verification, idempotent replay, forged-identity resistance) and test_release_supply_chain_adversarial.py::TestWrongProvenance/::TestArtifactTamperingAndDigestMismatch extend the same real provenance chain with adversarial proofs.
claims.note: The single register evidence key (prov) is supplied, proven against real SQLite/ArtifactStore infrastructure, not mocks.

claims.implementation: sbom.generate_sbom parses this repository's own real, canonical dependency manifests (backend/pyproject.toml's [project.dependencies] via tomllib, frontend/package.json's "dependencies") deterministically -- no network call, entries sorted by (ecosystem, name) so declaration order never affects the result. release_composition.compose_release_manifest registers the SBOM as a real C-14 artifact with real provenance (producer/task/spec-version/context-hash) and parents it under the final release manifest artifact.
claims.evidence: prov: test_sbom.py (10 tests: real manifest parsing, determinism, dev-dependency exclusion, PEP 508 constraint parsing) and test_release_composition.py (3 tests: real SBOM artifact registration with correct parent edges to the final manifest, real re-verification, real tamper detection).
claims.note: The single register evidence key (prov) is supplied.

claims.implementation: suspicious_package_review.review_sbom runs three real, local, deterministic checks over sbom.py's own SoftwareBillOfMaterials: unpinned dependencies (version_constraint == "*"), a small documented set of real historical typosquat incidents (npm crossenv/cross-env 2017, PyPI colourama/colorama), and name-confusable pairs within one ecosystem (Levenshtein distance <= 1). No network call, no external registry.
claims.evidence: sec: test_suspicious_package_review.py (10 tests, including this repository's own real SBOM earning a genuine re-derived clean==True result and a synthetic negative control proving each of the three checks can fire) and test_release_supply_chain_adversarial.py's own dependency-substitution proof (a substituted manifest immediately changes the SBOM, so a suspicious substitution is never hidden from review).
claims.note: The single register evidence key (sec) is supplied.

claims.implementation: Every VDC §Provenance field this requirement names is populated, never left default, by release_provenance.register_release_provenance: hash (the artifact's own real content address), producer/task (PRODUCER constant / candidate.release_id), provider/model ("none" -- packaging is fully deterministic, no AI provider is contacted), spec version ("C-31"), context hash (the candidate's own real core revision id). release_composition.py's final manifest artifact additionally carries real parent edges (the SBOM and suspicious-package-review artifacts), the fourth VDC field this requirement's own text names.
claims.evidence: prov: test_release_provenance.py::TestRegisterReleaseProvenance::test_registers_a_real_c14_artifact_with_every_vdc_provenance_field asserts each field directly against the real, persisted ArtifactProvenanceRecord; test_release_composition.py::TestComposeReleaseManifest::test_assembles_all_four_real_artifacts_with_correct_parent_edges proves the parent chain via ArtifactStore.parents_of, a real database read.
claims.note: The single register evidence key (prov) is supplied.
